example.title: Stone Arch Bridge, Second Street at Springfield Avenue over Boneyard Creek

brief: Small single stone arch of 1860 in a city centre, rebuilt around 2010 into the Boneyard Creek Second Street park: a semicircular arch of rough buff limestone voussoirs and rubble spandrels, now carrying a paved path/street edge with an ornamental black steel arched-picket railing between square cut-stone piers, with cascades and big limestone boulders along the channel and tall downtown buildings behind.

traits.railing_detail: ornamental steel picket railing between stone piers
